identity.name: NPR
identity.description: An American nonprofit public broadcaster providing national and international news, audio journalism and cultural coverage.

ownership.ownershipNotes: A nonprofit membership organisation funded by station fees, sponsorships, grants and listener support, not direct federal ownership. Public funding is a small and politically contested share.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Nonprofit public-media structure and published ethics guidelines; coverage includes criticism of both US parties.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Left-Center and High factual reporting; newsroom is professional but audience and story selection lean progressive.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is explanatory and social-policy oriented, without a consistent partisan programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames international news through a US public-media lens with attention to humanitarian and civil-liberties issues.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; established corrections and editorial standards.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: US public-radio voice. Combines explanatory audio journalism with domestic politics, health and science, generally within a liberal public-media framework.

selectionRationale: Adds a high-reliability US public-media perspective and audio-derived reporting, already active in the pipeline.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping treats NPR as Commercial Publisher; profile records Non-profit ownership. Mapping retained for compatibility and flagged for review. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
